prompts.text: What academic areas are you interested in exploring at Emory University and why?
prompts.applies_to: all first-year applicants (Emory College, Oxford College, or both)

prompts.text: Emory University has a strong commitment to building community. Tell us about a community that you have been part of where your personal participation helped to change or shape the community for the better.
prompts.applies_to: all first-year applicants (Emory College, Oxford College, or both); answer one of the four 'Getting to Know You' questions

prompts.text: Reflect on a personal experience where you intentionally expanded your cultural awareness.
prompts.applies_to: all first-year applicants (Emory College, Oxford College, or both); answer one of the four 'Getting to Know You' questions

prompts.text: Emory University’s unique mission calls for service to humanity. Share how you might personally contribute to this mission of service to humanity.
prompts.applies_to: all first-year applicants (Emory College, Oxford College, or both); answer one of the four 'Getting to Know You' questions

prompts.text: In a scholarly community, differing ideas often collide before they converge. How do you personally navigate disagreement in a way that promotes progress and deepens meaningful dialogue?
prompts.applies_to: all first-year applicants (Emory College, Oxford College, or both); answer one of the four 'Getting to Know You' questions

notes: Source is Emory's official admission blog post 'Emory's Short Answer Questions 2026-27' (dated August 1, 2026), which announces the questions 'for the 2026-2027 first-year application' and says they are the same as the previous cycle. Academic Interests is required and labeled '(200 Words Recommended Length)' - a recommended length, not necessarily a hard cap; recorded as word_limit 200. Getting to Know You: answer one of four, labeled '(150 Words)'. There are no separate Oxford College or Emory College prompts: one application covers Emory College, Oxford College, or both, and the same short answers apply (per Emory's blog and third-party guides; admission.emory.edu pages could not be loaded - 404/503 - so this was not re-confirmed on the main site or in the Common App itself). Exact Common App character caps, if any, were not verified. A non-breaking space in emory-5 was normalized to a regular space.
